fields.en: The fifth is not a tree. It is the bee, which visits all four and holds the year together, and it is the reason the calendar on this site exists at all.
fields.hr: Peta nije stablo. To je pčela, koja obilazi sva četiri i drži godinu na okupu, i zbog nje kalendar na ovoj stranici uopće postoji.

fields.en: Four trees, four forces on the same ground
fields.hr: Četiri stabla, četiri sile na istom tlu

fields.en: Honest limit: these four give fat and carbohydrate, not a complete diet. Protein comes from the chickpea in the terraces, and historically from the sea and from sheep. Nobody here ever lived on trees alone.
fields.hr: Poštena granica: ova četiri daju mast i ugljikohidrate, ne cjelovitu prehranu. Bjelančevine dolaze od slanutka na terasama, a povijesno od mora i od ovaca. Nitko ovdje nikad nije živio samo od stabala.

fields.en: Four trees
fields.hr: Četiri stabla

fields.en: Almond
fields.hr: Badem

fields.en: Roughly half fat. Left in the shell it keeps through to the next harvest with no work at all.
fields.hr: Otprilike pola masti. U ljusci izdrži do sljedeće berbe bez ikakvog posla.

fields.en: Carbohydrate
fields.hr: Ugljikohidrati

fields.en: Needs only drying
fields.hr: Traži samo sušenje

fields.en: Fat
fields.hr: Mast

fields.en: Fig
fields.hr: Smokva

fields.en: Dried on a rack in the sun. Sugar concentrates, and a good year feeds you until the next one.
fields.hr: Suši se na lesi na suncu. Šećer se koncentrira, i dobra godina te hrani do sljedeće.

fields.en: Holm oak
fields.hr: Crnika

fields.en: Tannins leached out, then ground to flour and baked. Acorn bread has been made on Mediterranean islands since the Palaeolithic.
fields.hr: Iz žira se ispiru tanini, pa se melje u brašno i peče. Kruh od žira peče se na mediteranskim otocima još od paleolitika.

fields.en: Olive
fields.hr: Maslina

fields.en: Bitter and inedible off the tree. Cured or pressed. Oil keeps a year in a dark jar.
fields.hr: Gorka i nejestiva sa stabla. Konzervira se ili tiješti. Ulje se drži godinu dana u tamnoj boci.

fields.en: Needs work
fields.hr: Traži rad

fields.en: These four carry the project. Not because they are the only species going in, but because each one solves a different problem that this land sets, and between them they cover the whole of it. Every one of them was growing here long before anyone wrote anything down.
fields.hr: Ova četiri nose projekt. Ne zato što su jedine vrste koje idu u zemlju, nego zato što svako rješava drugi problem koji ova zemlja postavlja, a zajedno pokrivaju cijeli. Sva četiri rasla su ovdje davno prije nego je itko išta zapisao.

fields.en: They also work in two pairs
fields.hr: Rade i u dva para

fields.en: Look at what comes off these four trees and they sort themselves twice over. Two of them give fat, which is dense, slow energy that keeps. Two give carbohydrate, which is quick energy. And crossing that, two of them have to be worked before a human can eat them at all, while two only need to be dried.
fields.hr: Pogledaj što daju ta četiri stabla i sama se poslože dvaput. Dva daju mast, gustu i sporu energiju koja se čuva. Dva daju ugljikohidrate, brzu energiju. A poprijeko tome, dva se moraju obraditi da bi ih čovjek uopće mogao jesti, dok se druga dva samo osuše.

fields.en: That second axis is not a footnote. The two foods that need work are the two that were most valued, because the labour was the storage. In Sardinia, acorn bread sold for more than wheat bread precisely because it was harder to make, and the women who made it were known for it. The Latin name of the holm oak, ilex, is thought to come from eligo, to choose. It was the tree that got chosen.
fields.hr: Ta druga os nije fusnota. Dvije namirnice koje traže rad bile su i najcjenjenije, jer je rad bio način čuvanja. Na Sardiniji se kruh od žira prodavao skuplje od pšeničnog upravo zato što ga je bilo teže napraviti, a žene koje su ga pekle bile su po tome poznate. Latinsko ime crnike, ilex, izvodi se iz eligo, izabrati. To je bilo stablo koje se biralo.
